Baltimore (2-1) hosts Tennessee (0-3) in NFL Week 4 at MAndT Bank Stadium. Last week, Baltimore beat Dallas, 34-31, as Lamar Jackson threw for two touchdowns and finished 15-of-20 passing for 186 yards. The Titans lost 12-7 to the Giants.
NFL Football - Kansas City Chiefs at Las Vegas Raiders
